name: tufts-sync
summary: Experiment: Tufts' Wing Dive dashes on the player's own screen at once and the server follows (WaitNetSync OnlyServerWait), instead of the screen waiting for the server

assets.why: Tufts, Wing Dive (Space): the two sync points before the dash were OnlyClientWait (the player's screen waits a round trip for the server, then both dash at different times); OnlyServerWait lets the player's screen dash at once and the server catch up, the usual predicted pattern.
